Validate the plate-to-set metadata used for matched controls

Source: R/experiment_metadata.R
validate_metadata.Rd

One row must represent one independent plate photographed once. set_id defines which treatment and control plates are biologically comparable; controls are never borrowed from a different set. Use globally unique plate IDs and file basenames. Repeated photographs of the same plate are not new replicates.

Usage

validate_metadata(metadata, files = NULL, control = "control")

Arguments

metadata

Data frame containing file, plate_id, set_id and treatment. treatment must equal control for controls. Other labels identify treatments consistently across sets. Optional zymo_strain, medium and day must be complete and constant within each set if present.

files

Optional vector of image paths. Exactly these images must appear once in metadata; no unmatched or unused rows are accepted.

control

Exact label used for control plates, default control.

Value

The validated metadata, invisibly. Errors explain invalid mappings.
